messages:
incident-bot: Pager severity=SEV2: embedder-queue-tail errors rising in us-west-2 (20% 5xx, p95 latency 1.2s). Route: eng-oncall-erin. Alert: https://alerts.internal/r/ABC123
eng-oncall-erin: Ack. I'm on pager. collecting logs + stack traces. tagging @mike_sre for infra impact.
mike_sre: looking now — I can see spikes on the shard group (embedder-7). CPU is fine, queue depth growing; KV cache miss rate up ~3x.
julia_prod: Customer support stack reporting a few users seeing timeouts, but not yet widespread. I'll open an incident page for customer comms.
eng-oncall-erin: quick mitigation: enabling short circuit fallback to smaller embedding model for requests hitting embedder-7. Applying policy: `route.fallback=embedder-small, max_inflight=50`
ops-bot: Deploy job started: patch/reroute-embedder-fallback (ci/3421) — logs: https://ci.internal/job/3421
mike_sre: Confirmed KV cache TTL values for embedder-7 were recently changed in config rollout 2 hours ago. Rolling that back to previous TTL=300s for now: `kubectl -n inference set env ds/embedder-7 CACHE_TTL=300`
eng-oncall-erin: Rollback applied and traffic draining. p95 latency dropping to 400ms, 5xx back to ~2%. Good.
pm-ash: Thanks team. Can we capture action items and hit postmortem scheduling while still in mitigation? I want to ensure remediation doesn't fall through.
tanvi: +1. I'll own action item tracking. Suggesting: 1) postmortem, 2) config audit + guardrail, 3) improved alerting for KV miss surge. Size: postmortem small (2), config guardrail medium (5), alerting small (3).
julia_prod: Noted customer impact: ~12 customers saw degraded responses in the 20:10-20:45 UTC window. Liaising with support for targeted outreach.
eng-oncall-erin: Handing off to mike_sre for remediation work and root cause while I wrap the livepage: mike, can you own the remediation ticket and the rollback follow-up?
mike_sre: I can take remediation. Creating ticket INF-4729 and linking config rollback notes + runbook. ETA: initial RCA draft by EOD tomorrow.
tanvi: Assigned INF-4729 to @mike_sre. I'll create sub-tasks for the quarterly backlog: Q2-Infra (config-guardrails), Q2-Eval (stress testing embedder TTLs).
eng-oncall-erin: Post-incident: schedule postmortem meeting (30m) — proposing tomorrow 10:00 PDT. @pm-ash can you confirm?
pm-ash: 10:00 PDT works for me. Invite product, eng-runtime, SRE, and support. Agenda: timeline, RCA, action items, owner & size, and rollout plan for guardrail.
julia_prod: Add customer comms review to agenda; need messaging for impacted customers.
eng-oncall-erin: Quick notes for the postmortem doc: root cause hypothesis = config rollout increased KV eviction sensitivity on embedder-7 leading to cache-miss storm -> queue pressure -> elevated latencies & 5xx.
mike_sre: Data to attach: kube events, embedder logs, cache miss rate graph, rollout diffs. I'll populate INF-4729 and link graphs.
tanvi: For prioritization: recommend guardrail work be P1 for Q2 due to customer-visible impact; estimate 5 engineer-weeks (spread across infra + runtime). Alerting improvements P2, 2 engineer-weeks. Postmortem doc: 2 engineer-days.
eng-oncall-erin: Agreed. We'll create a remediation epic and map to Q2 planning. @pm-ash please sign off on priority and tie to Q2 workstreams.
pm-ash: Signed. I'll put the epic in the roadmap and request one sprint of allocation for the config guardrail. We'll revisit the sizing after RCA.
ops-bot: INF-4729 created by mike_sre. Links: https://tracker.internal/INF-4729.
eng-oncall-erin: Closing live mitigation thread — system stabilized, fallback route still enabled until guardrail rollout. Postmortem invite sent. Thanks all for quick responses :thumbsup:
mike_sre: Following up in INF-4729 with next steps.
tanvi: I'll track owners + status in the remediation board and mark action items with sizes as discussed.
julia_prod: I'll prepare customer notes for tomorrow after RCA draft.
eng-oncall-erin: Last check: any outstanding customer escalations?
julia_prod: One active ticket for an enterprise customer, support is on the call. We'll update postmortem with any impact details.
eng-oncall-erin: OK. Last_message_ts=2945678968 — thread archived to incident inbox.
